audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer tracks a fabricated ability called 'Repeating Dashes' — it appears in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, tradeGood, three phase lines, the cooldown block, the trading block, both do's, the don'ts and five report slots. No such ability exists. The two interactions that actually decide the lane are absent.
audit.why: Ambessa's passive is Drakehound's Step: 'Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed, and refunding energy.' That is the repeating dash. Two real interactions were never stated: Repudiation 'deals increased damage if she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing', so poking a braced Ambessa feeds her slam; and Public Execution 'suppresses them upon her arrival', which ends a Shield of Durand channel outright.
audit.corrected: Every 'Repeating Dashes' replaced with Drakehound's Step, and the Repudiation brace-punish plus the Public Execution suppression written into the trading, cooldown, don'ts and key-interaction slots.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Ambessa 'him' and 'his' in tradeBad, dontsFull[0].d, report[9] and report[10]; report[2] says 'neither side owns this lane' while both charts give Ambessa four of seven stages.
audit.why: Ambessa is female, and the content layer already uses 'she'. The chart is not neutral: she takes 2, 3, first item and 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in the edited lines and the chart summary rewritten to describe the actual split.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why claims Stormsurge/Riftmaker is your spike on a stage the chart gives Ambessa, phases[4].why ends with the boilerplate 'Reassess his ultimate too', and no cooldown or resource number appears anywhere.
audit.why: Cunning Sweep 14s at rank 1, Repudiation 18s, Lacerate 13s, Public Execution 130s and 1250 range. Every ability costs her 70 energy, which is the real limiter on her chain — that is the number a Galio can actually count.
audit.corrected: Stage lines rewritten around her energy pool and the three cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'Oblivion Orb early — his healing fights your trade math' and leaves boots as a coin flip.
audit.why: Nothing in Riot's text for Ambessa heals. Her damage is physical, so Plated Steelcaps is the boot, and Zhonya's is the answer to a Public Execution commit.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal line removed, boots and Zhonya's justified.

edits.before: Level 1 is the one stage you hold: Ambessa has no level-1 dash to open with, so she has to walk into your Winds of War tornado to start anything, and the converging center column punishes that approach. But once her dash-stacking combo and W come online around 2-3 the lane tilts hard — she weaves her mobility through your slow Justice Punch wind-up, so your knockup whiffs and the taunt off Shield of Durand never channels before her chain CC and W land. Do not throw E speculatively; she dashes through the dead air and chunks you on the recovery. Last-hit with the tip of your Q tornado and only commit your taunt once her dashes are already spent.
edits.after: Level 1 is the one stage you hold: Ambessa has no level-1 dash to open with, so she has to walk into your Winds of War tornado to start anything, and the converging center column punishes that approach. From 2-3 the lane tilts hard — Drakehound's Step gives her a free dash off every ability cast, so she weaves through your slow Justice Punch wind-up and Lacerate lands before the Shield of Durand taunt ever channels. Do not throw E speculatively; she dashes through the dead air and chunks you on the recovery. Last-hit with the tip of your Q and only commit the taunt once her 70-energy casts have run her dry.

edits.before: By Levels 4-5 your Q-W-E combo is fully online and that is your one contesting window: if she over-commits her dashes and her mobility is on cooldown, channeling Shield of Durand into a Justice Punch knockup can punish her — your W's magic amplification does nothing against her physical damage, but the taunt and the flat reduction still buy the trade. Level 6 is your real swing: Hero's Entrance does not win you the 1v1, but its long-range drop and landing taunt-knockup mean the correct play in a losing lane is to roam and crash another fight rather than feed her here. Bait her into burning her dashes, then taunt her mid-combo.
edits.after: By Levels 4-5 your Q-W-E combo is online and that is your one contesting window: if she has burned her dashes and her energy is dry, channelling Shield of Durand into a Justice Punch knockup punishes her — the W's magic amplification does nothing against her physical damage, but the taunt and flat reduction still buy the trade. Never poke into a braced Repudiation, because blocked non-minion damage makes her slam hit harder. Level 6 is the real swing: Public Execution suppresses you straight out of the W channel, so stop duelling and spend Hero's Entrance crashing another fight instead.
